Vimlesh Sonawane

Project Manager

I’m Vimlesh Sonawane, a project manager who turns complex, many-stakeholder work into delivered results. Over 5+ years, I’ve co-founded and delivered two residential builds in Pune with zero scope deviation, run AI-supported IP enforcement operations at Amazon as the single point of contact for legal teams, brands, and leadership, earning the Most Valued Player Award, and planned live programs in Boston with partners including JPMorgan Chase and the Museum of African American History. A civil engineer and PMI GAC Scholar, I’m completing my MS in Project Management at Northeastern University, and I bring disciplined scope, schedule, and cost control, backed by data.
